Name: stanloona420's Sebastian Revised for Seasonal Cute
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]I recieved a request to finish the rest of stanaloona's revised bachelor's for Seasonal Cute. So here they are![/size]

[size=4]This one contains [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11294?tab=posts]Sebastian Revised[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27480]Sebastian Revised with Glasses[/url], now compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetics[/url]. There are 3 different versions you can choose from:[/size]

[size=4]Version 1: Shorter hair[/size]
[size=4]Version 2: Longer more emo hair[/size]
[size=4]Version 3: Emo hair with glasses[/size]

[size=4]All assets used were either open permission or I was granted permission to use. Assets used provided by:[/size]
[size=4]stanaloona420[/size]
[size=4]Poltergeister[/size]
[size=4]Ailin[/size]
[size=4]IronZelly[/size]
[size=4]Mo/YumeRobo233[/size]


[size=4]Download the version you want and overwrite your Seasonal Cute assets with the included ones.[/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]
